# Gaia

Gaia Community is a self-hosted web GIS for data analysts. Notebooks, layers, and print layouts run on your own machines.

## Preferred sources
- https://gaiagis.org/
- https://gaiagis.org/en/
- https://gaiagis.org/en/product/
- https://gaiagis.org/en/install/
- https://github.com/greenmice-technologies/gaia

## Machine-readable resources
- https://gaiagis.org/sitemap.xml
- https://gaiagis.org/en/index.json
